output.reason: The brief is convincing because three separate pieces of evidence line up: a bench test with no people present, a comparison against the eight robots still on 6.3 working the same zones, and Zone C staying flat. Together these explain why the August wrap change did nothing until the September firmware upgrade, and the next steps are clear (go back to matte film, roll back firmware as a fallback, reject the three-strike policy and shorter fields), though it doesn't say how rollback squares with 6.3 security support ending on 31 October.
